name: Thickness Computation via Additive Depth Blending
aliases: NVIDIA Fog Volume SDK Thickness Method
Thickness computation via additive depth blending
definition: Computes the thickness of a non-convex object by summing the depths of all front-facing and back-facing intersections per pixel and subtracting them. Solves the limitation of simple back-minus-front depth difference, which fails for non-convex geometry with multiple ray intersections.
